description: A LaTeX project in. Its pages, formulas, figures and tables out, with what each tool would cost for it, in cents. Free, with a key. Up to 24 MB for the project. A project that cannot be built costs nothing; the answer gives the file and line.

archive.description: Instead of files: the whole project as one .zip or .tar.gz, base64-encoded.

binary_files.description: Figures and other binary files by path, each base64-encoded. PNG and JPEG are placed as they are; a PDF, EPS or SVG figure is answered with its name, to be saved as a PNG.

files.description: The project's text files by their path inside the project, each file's whole text: the .tex files, and any .bib, .bbl, .sty, .cls or .tikz of your own. Example: {"main.tex": "\\documentclass{article}...", "chapters/one.tex": "..."}.

main.description: The path of the main .tex file. Needed only when the project has more than one.

name: count_project

cost_cents.description: What each paid tool would cost for this project.

title: Count a project
